newsitem.title: USA: Suspects sought in Calif. road murder of 2-year-old.
newsitem.headline: Suspects sought in Calif. road murder of 2-year-old.

text.p: Police Saturday searched for the killer of a two-year-old boy who was shot when a passing vehicle opened fire on his father's car.
The victim, Robert James, was shot in the head Friday in this desert town roughly an hour east of Los Angeles when his father tried to get away from a car whose driver was menacing them.

A spokeswoman for the San Bernardino County Sheriff's Department said the boy's father was driving down a highway when a car cut in front of him and began taunting him by speeding up and then abruptly slamming on the breaks.

When the father tried to change lanes, the passenger in the other car leaned out the window and fired 12 or 13 shots. The boy was shot and driven to a nearby hospital, where the boy was pronounced dead. The boy's father, his mother and six-year-old sister, who were also in the car, were uninjured.
